The '''HH-87 Starhopper''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used commonly by various factions of the criminal underworld. Notably, the craft saw widespread use by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime families and [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:HH87Starhopper2-SWE.png|thumb|left|180px|A Starhopper in landing configuration]]
The long-ranged starfighter was 6.8 meters long with a 13.59 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] wingspan. The craft's design was largely influenced by the tastes of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal empire: with visible armor platings and a prominent prow, the Starhopper displayed the Hutts' aggressiveness. Equipped with twin [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and compact [[stabilizer wing]]s, the long-range craft was suited to a various number of activities carried out by seedy underworld organizations.<ref name="databank" />

==Role==
Starhoppers were used commonly by the Hutts to patrol the skies above their homeworld, [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In addition, the Hutts used the Starhopper to hunt down wayward debtors.<ref name="databank" /> The craft fell into the hands of various other seedy organizations, including the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. The [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] kept a number of them on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] which were stationed at the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]].<ref name="Escape">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:HH87Starhopper-SWE.jpg|thumb|250px|right|An HH-87 Starhopper in flight through space]]
The starfighters saw a combat role by the Zygerrian slavers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year of the war]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|Battle of Kadavo]], at least two Starhoppers were deployed when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the intention of freeing the captured [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] populace of the artisan colony world [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Two Zygerrians piloted HH-87 Starhoppers against the [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]] and Koon's ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]''. After one of the Zygerrian pilots managed to damage the Z-95 piloted by a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] named [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]], Koon destroyed both Starhoppers.<ref name="Escape" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Starhopper's first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] was "[[Escape from Kadavo]]," the thirteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the television series [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]].

The craft's design was based on original concept art for the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]] seen in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="trivia">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep413|text="Escape from Kadavo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 6}}</ref>
